messages:
maria: heads-up — a CS ticket: customer sends mixed-dim batch and sees unit spike, wants explanation

dan: link to the ticket? can we repro?

maria: https://redwood.internal/t/12345 — repro included. payload: mixed 1536 and 512 vectors in same request. they send 10 items, got charged as if 10x1536.

sree: ugh. sounds like our estimator is using max(dim) for the whole batch. that was known for simple routing but shouldn't leak to billing.

alek: right now the runtime builds a unified chunk plan by slotting to the largest shape for alignment. cheaper for latency but inflates estimated units.

zoe: interesting Q: is this a billing bug or an explanatory mismatch (console showing units vs actual routed work)?

maria: both. console shows "units: 15360" which matches what customer was billed. they expected per-item units.

sree: proposal: add a per-request breakdown in billing & telemetry: samples_by_dim and charged_units_by_dim. we already emit trace tags for shape, just not aggregated in billing pipeline.

dan: agree. but we need to decide whether to change billing retrospectively for these customers or just clarify UI/SDK. retrospective changes are risky.

alek: alternative: offer a server-side "smart-split" mode that splits mixed-dim batches into per-dim subrequests and routes them separately, preserving packing benefits for same-dim groups. that would reduce billed units but increase scheduling churn.

zoe: can we expose a quick preflight endpoint to estimate units without actually charging? SDK can call it and surface warnings.

maria: +1. minimal ops risk. call it /v1/embeddings:estimate with same shape header: ``X-Embed-Shape-Hint: [1536,512,...]`` and returns {estimated_units:..., breakdown:[{dim:1536,count:...}, ...]}.

sree: telemetry-wise we should emit a new metric: `embed.shape_estimate_error.{dim}` measuring delta between preflight estimate and actual charged units. that will help tune heuristics.

dan: how do we guarantee preflight matches runtime packing? race conditions if queues change. preflight should be conservative (ceil). else SDK will underreport.

alek: true. conservative prefight may overwarn. tradeoff. maybe preflight can return two numbers: lower_bound_estimate and conservative_estimate. SDK shows the conservative one by default but console shows both.

zoe: UX question: where in Console do we show per-dim breakdown? per-route modal? per-invoice line item?

maria: MVP: per-route recent 24h breakdown and per-request trace link that expands to per-dim units. then follow-up: add invoice grouping.

ingest-bot: deploy plan created: canary preflight API beta on eng-platform cluster (10% of SDK calls) scheduled for 2026-04-12 06:00 UTC.

sree: for rollout we need two toggles: runtime smart-split toggle and telemetry-only toggle. start with telemetry-only + preflight enabled for SDK calls to gather concordance.

dan: SLO concerns — smart-split will increase request count and might affect p99. add e2e load test.

alek: I'll add bench: mixed-dim worst-case throughput and p99 increase estimate. also quantify scheduling overhead (extra RPCs).

zoe: Admin/console changes: add a tenant flag to show per-dim billing and a small explainer tooltip. I can wire a mockup.

maria: Devex: SDK change is small: add optional preflight call and a `shape_hint` parameter in batching helpers. also add opt-in env var `REDWOOD_EMB_SHAPE_PREFLIGHT=1` for early customers.

dan: security & quota note: preflight calls should be rate-limited and not count toward free credits abuse. mark them as 'estimate' in billing pipeline.

sree: question for infra: how expensive is doing preflight? can it piggyback on header negotiation without full scheduling?

alek: yes, preflight can run simplified packing heuristics without scheduling. cheap CPU but still requires the router to compute slotting. should be fine at scale if 10% canary.

zoe: timeline: wire telemetry + console mock by EOD Friday, preflight API canary next week, runtime smart-split after metrics look good (~2-3 weeks).

maria: action items: Alek add bench PR, Zoe add console mock, Sree add metric + alert, Dan coordinate canary timing with infra. I'll follow up with CS on ticket.

sree: ack. will add `embed.shape_mismatch.count` and `embed.shape_estimate_delta.p95` alerts to platform-dashboard.

maria: thanks all :rocket:
